name: czrecoil_frame_start_campaign_mode_1
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuStartCampaignMode dispatches campaign mode id 2 through RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndSetupSensorTracker.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x431290 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
The native smoke patches only the smoke process: RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndSetupSensorTracker is redirected with a temporary code jump and restored before return.
functional_evidence: The grouped native smoke verifies campaign mode id 2 with null zbd path, skipIntroFmvMode 1, and m_useArchiveBanks forwarded as missionFlags.
